run_evaluate: run the evaluate function to test a model checkpoint on a dataset and save results
run_main: run the main entry point to start evaluation with Hydra config for the Omnimatterf model
create_make_masked: create a masked image by overlaying colored masks onto an RGB image using make_masked
review_evaluate: review the evaluate function that iterates over a dataset, runs inference, and computes frame metrics
summarize_make_masked: summarize the make_masked function that blends colored masks into an image using predefined mask colors
